intervals.label: installation and commissioning
intervals.note: The carpet installation was completed in June 2006; the guard ring was completed in spring 2007 and connected to the DAQ in November 2007 (Montini et al., arXiv:1608.01251). Start of construction is not stated in the sources read.
intervals.quote: The ARGO-YBJ experiment started recording data with the whole central carpet in June 2006. The period until autumn 2007 has been mainly devoted to installation and debugging operations

intervals.label: stable data taking
intervals.quote: The ARGO-YBJ experiment has been in stable data taking from November 2007 till February 2013

intervals.label: data taking ended
intervals.note: Start is the end of stable data taking.

summary.plain: A floor of particle counters, about the size of a football pitch, laid edge to edge on a Tibetan plateau to see small air showers.
summary.technical: Full-coverage RPC carpet (~78 × 74 m2, 18,480 pads of 56 × 60 cm2, 6 cm strips) with 0.5 cm lead converter and a partially instrumented guard ring to about 100 × 100 m2; time resolution about 1.8 ns.

technology.quote: The detector consists of a single layer of RPCs (Resistive Plate Counters) covering an area of ~6700 m2
technology.value: A single layer of resistive plate counters covering the whole central floor (about 78 × 74 m2) with a lead converter, read out as 18,480 pads.
